Ashokkumar  Shrimali  
40 K patelvas,  Gamtal Pase, 385001  Virpur,  Palanpur, Gujarat.  
+91 7359731529  | shrimaliashokkumar673@gmail.com  
LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashokkumar -shrimali -ab726091/  
 
Professional  Summary  
Results -driven  Big Data  and Business  Analytics  Master's  graduate  with strong  foundations  in data scien ce, statistics,  and 
the energy sector. Proficient in data analysis, visualization, and cloud data platforms including Databricks and  Azure. 
Demonstrated ability to implement machine learning models, automate data workflows, and support business insights. 
Strong communicator with a proactive mindset, well -versed in tools such as Python, SQL, REST APIs, and Power BI.  
 
Work  Experience  
Data  Engineer  | TÜNKERS  Maschinenbau  GmbH  — Ford-Werke  | Köln,  Germany  | 08/2024  - 04/2025  
- Leveraged  Python  scripting  to assist  in AGV  control  checks,  error  reporting,  and log data extraction  for performance 
analysis.  
- Monitored  AGV  movements,  ensuring  smooth  process  execution  and resolving  navigation  and automation  issues.  
 
Risk Analyst  | RWE  Supply  and Trading  GmbH  | Essen,  Germany  | 08/2023  - 02/2024  
- Performed  data analysis  using  Python,  SQL,  and Azure  Databricks  to optimize  decision -making  by 15%.  
- Extracted  and normalized  product  data from emails  and Excel  using  automation  with REST  APIs.  
- Designed  and monitored  Databricks  workflows,  enhancing  processing  efficiency  by 20%.  
- Developed  dashboards  and prototypes  improving  user interaction  and engagement  on Databricks.  
 
Healthcare  Data  Analyst  | Dios Life Sciences  Pvt Ltd | India  | 03/2018 - 08/2021  
- Developed  ETL pipelines  in Azure  Data  Factory  for healthcare data.  
- Reduced  data delivery  time by 30% through  optimized  data flow. 
- Created  Power  BI dashboards  enabling  faster  decision -making  for sales.  
 
Business  Executive  | Intas  Pharmaceutical  Ltd | India  | 06/2014  - 02/2018  
- Achieved  a 25% sales  increase  through  strategic  communication  and client  engagement.  
- Represented  the company  in 20+ industry  events,  growing  network  reach  and partnerships.  
 
Data  Executive  | Nikhar  Surgical  Hospital  | India  | 09/2011  - 05/2014  
- Improved  operational  efficiency  by 20% through  pharmacy  data system  enhancements.  
- Boosted  patient  service  outcomes  via data analysis  and cross -functional  collaboration.  
 
Education  
M.Sc.  in Big Data  & Business  Analytics  
FOM  University  of Applied  Sciences,  Essen,  Germany  | 09/2021  - 02/2024  
 
Bachelor  of Pharmacy  
Indukaka  Ipcowala  College  of Pharmacy,  India  | 08/2006  - 04/2011  
 
Projects  
- Sentiment  Analysis  of Movie  Reviews:  Compared  TextBlob,  Vader,  and AutoML;  selected  best-performing  model.  
- Myocardial  Infarction  Prediction:  Applied  ML algorithms  to predict  heart  attacks  with improved  accuracy.  
- Crypto  Asset  Forecasting:  Finalist  at Refinitiv  Hackathon  2022;  improved  forecast  accuracy  by 20%.  
- Skin Tone  Analysis  System:  Patented  AI-based  system;  reduced  product  return  rates  by 60%.  

Technical  Skills  
Programming:  Python,  SQL,  R, C++,  C#, PySpark,  Spark SQL 
Cloud  Platforms:  Azure  (ADF,  Data  Lake,  Delta  Lake,  Databricks),  AWS,  GCP,  Redshift,  S3, Lambda,  EC2 
DevOps Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub, CI/CD Pipelines  
Data  Tools:  Power  BI, Tableau,  Jupyter  Notebooks,  REST  APIs 
OS & Office: Linux, Windows, MS Office, Mac OS 
Methodologies: Agile, Scrum  
 
Certifications  
- Oracle  Machine  Learning  using  Autonomous  Database  2023  Certified  Associate  
- Certified  in Azure  Databricks  & Data  Engineering  
- Master  Python  with 100 Projects  in 100 Days  
- DevOps  for Absolute  Beginners  
 
Languages  
English  (C1),  German  (A2),  Hindi  (Native),  Gujarati  (Native)  
 
Interests  
Cricket,  Reading,  Singing
